note_zh: 最後一部風機 2026 年 3 月 13 日完成安裝。2026 年 4 月底達到購售電合約的商轉門檻、州長 4 月 27 日宣布與麻州電力公司的合約生效（商轉日 4 月 24 日見於 Unitil 的 SEC 季報，網頁無法抓取，待查證），但當時 62 部中只有 55 部能發電、且未全部滿載。2026 年 9 月 16–17 日與 GE Vernova 和解時，開發商只說「所有風機都能發電」，當地媒體指出不清楚是否已全部完成試運轉。查不到明確「全部 62 部全面商轉／滿載」的來源，列為不明；無論如何開始商業運轉的年份都是 2026。
note_en: The last turbine was installed on 13 March 2026. The contract commissioning threshold was reached and the power contracts with the Massachusetts utilities took effect in late April 2026, announced by the governor on 27 April (a 24 April commercial operation date appears in a Unitil SEC 10-Q that could not be fetched, so it is unverified), but at that point only 55 of the 62 turbines could generate and not all at full capacity. When the GE Vernova dispute was settled on 16–17 September 2026 the developer said only that all turbines are capable of producing power, and local press noted it was unclear whether they were fully commissioned. No source states that all 62 turbines are fully commissioned, so this is left unclear; either way commercial operation began in 2026.
